messages:
aj: FYI — I'm proposing a role lifecycle change in the Console. We want to split the current `editor` role into `editor` (content-level edits) + `manager` (project-level config + billing). Goal: reduce privilege blast radius and fix a recurring implicit-perm leak. Looking for input on UI gating, audit events around KMS, and migration strategy.

maria: quick Q — will `viewer` still be able to list secrets metadata? we saw viewer => API keys list leak in prod last month.

sam: we need to ensure any role split still respects KMS envelope grants. last rotation showed principals with `editor` kept decrypt rights via legacy policy.

olivia: strong +1 for finer roles. UI gating: can we hide config buttons unless user has `project.manage`? currently we do front-end checks only which are flaky. recommend server-side enforcement + feature flag.

aj: agreed. plan sketch: 1) server-side permission checks (enforce at API gate) 2) feature-flagged UI gating (`rbac_ui_split_roles`) 3) migration job to reclassify existing `editor` assignments into editor/manager via heuristics + owner review 4) audit log enrichment for KMS ops. timeline: 2w for server checks + flag, 1w for migration dry-run, canary roll after.

sam: pseudo-check to standardize (pls comment):
```
// simplified auth check (API layer)
if (!actor.hasPermission('project.update', project.id)) {
  return 403
}
if (actor.role == 'viewer' && request.path.startsWith('/secrets')) {
  return 403
}
```
Need to add explicit KMS grant lookup for `kms:decrypt` when assigning `manager`.

maria: for audit logs, we should emit a structured event when migration changes a role or when KMS grant is attached/detached. example: 
`AUDIT: {"event":"role_change","actor":"aj","target_user":"u123","from":"editor","to":"manager","reason":"migration heuristics","kms_grant":true}`
include request_id and hash of affected resource IDs.

rbac-bot: policy-lint: implicit-permission leak scanner ran on `main` — found `console:v2` route where `viewer` still bypasses gating via legacy frontend flag. See: https://internal/policy-lint/1736123456 (reacted :eyes:)

olivia: action items:
- aj + sam: implement API enforcement by EOD Friday behind `rbac_ui_split_roles` flag
- maria: add audit event schema + sample logs to spec doc
- olivia: write migration heuristics and review list (owner review step)
- eng-sre: prepare canary env with KMS rotation test

aj: I'll draft RFC with migration steps and rollback plan. quick question for security: do we want the migration to automatically attach `kms:decrypt` to new `manager` role, or require manual grants? auto-attach reduces friction but increases risk if heuristics are wrong.

sam: prefer manual attach by default. add a `--auto-attach-kms` opt-in for orgs that opt into automated migration. Also add post-migration audit sampling.

maria: I'll prototype the audit pipeline additions and a Kibana dashboard for sampling. will drop a README with log field names.

aj: thanks all. I'll create the RFC + PRs and tag you. tagging @olivia for final signoff on migration heuristics. (reacted :thumbsup:)
